name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Central sector direct income support scheme for all landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs and domestic requirements.

eligibility_rules.landholding_criteria: Must possess cultivable landholding in revenue records
exclusions: Serving or retired civil servants (Group A, B, C)
Income tax payers in preceding assessment year

required_documents: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar (NPCI mapped)
benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
application_method: Online self-registration on PM-KISAN portal, Common Service Centers (CSC), or through State Nodal Revenue Officers.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
description: World's largest publicly funded health assurance mission, offering secondary and tertiary healthcare coverage to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Entitled families based on deprivation and occupational criteria of Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) and all senior citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income.

required_documents: Ration Card or Family Samagra ID
PM-JAY Family Letter or Beneficiary Identification Slip
benefits: ₹5,00,000 per family per year for cashless and paperless hospitalization treatment across 29,000+ empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide.
application_method: Verification at nearest empaneled hospital, Ayushman Mitra counter, Common Service Center, or online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in.

name: PMAY-U (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Centrally sponsored flagship urban housing mission to provide all-weather pucca homes with water, sanitation, and electricity to eligible urban households.

eligibility_rules.housing_criteria: The beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in their name anywhere in India.
special_conditions: Female head of the family preferred as owner or co-owner

required_documents: Affidavit of not owning a pucca house in India
benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakhs on home loans under CLSS, or Central assistance grant of ₹1.5 Lakhs per house under Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP) and BLC.
application_method: Online application via pmaymis.gov.in portal or through Municipal Corporation / Urban Local Body (ULB) housing desks.
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Rural housing assistance program providing financial assistance to houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses in rural areas.

eligibility_rules.housing_criteria: Households without shelter or living in zero, one, or two room kutcha houses with kutcha roof based on SECC and Awaas+ survey.

benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plains and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas, plus 90-95 days of unskilled labor wage under MGNREGA, and ₹12,000 for toilet construction under SBM.
application_method: Identified through Gram Sabha verified lists on AwaasSoft, assisted by Gram Panchayat Secretary / Block Development Office.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.

eligibility_rules.education_criteria: Passed Matriculation / 10th or higher from recognized Board/University

required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by Competent Revenue Authority
College / Institute Fee Receipt and Bonafide Certificate
benefits: 100% non-refundable compulsory course fee reimbursement + Monthly academic allowance up to ₹13,500 per annum depending on course group and hosteller/day scholar status.
application_method: Online submission via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with institute-level verification.

name: PM-USP Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC / EBC / DNT Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scholarship assistance for students from Other Backward Classes, Economically Backward Classes, and De-notified Tribes pursuing higher education.
required_documents: OBC / EBC / DNT Caste Certificate (Non-Creamy Layer)
benefits: Academic allowance up to ₹10,000 per annum and reimbursement of non-refundable tuition fees directly through DBT.
application_method: Online via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: PMMY (Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
description: Refinance scheme facilitating collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 Lakhs to micro and small non-corporate, non-farm enterprises.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Any Indian citizen having a viable business plan for non-farm income-generating activity.

required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
Business Project Report / Quotation of machinery
benefits: Collateral-free micro loans across 4 tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹10 Lakhs), and Tarun Plus (₹10 Lakhs to ₹20 Lakhs).
application_method: Directly at Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, or via digital portal udyamimitra.in.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Financial enablement initiative to promote entrepreneurship among women and Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe individuals for setting up greenfield enterprises.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Enterprise must be a greenfield project in manufacturing, services, trading, or agri-allied sectors.

required_documents: Partnership deed / MOA (if entity has non-SC/ST/women shareholding, must hold minimum 51% equity)
benefits: Composite bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore covering up to 85% of total project cost.
application_method: Apply online at standupmitra.in or through bank branches with SIDBI handholding support.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Special micro-credit facility empowering urban street vendors to resume their livelihood businesses without demanding collateral.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Vending in urban areas on or before 24 March 2020 holding Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by ULB.

required_documents: Vending Certificate or ID Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) where certificate not issued
Bank Account details linked to Aadhaar
benefits: Initial working capital loan of ₹10,000; on timely repayment eligible for ₹20,000 (2nd tranche) and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche). Interest subsidy of 7% credited per annum, plus monthly digital cashback up to ₹100.
application_method: Online on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in portal or via Banking Correspondents (BCs) / Common Service Centers (CSC).
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Comprehensive institutional support for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 family-based trades.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Artisans engaged in one of the 18 targeted traditional family trades; limited to one member per family.

benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID, Basic 5-7 days skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 e-voucher toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakhs (₹1 Lakh tier 1 + ₹2 Lakhs tier 2) at subsidized 5% interest rate.
application_method: Enrolment through CSC centers on pmvishwakarma.gov.in with Gram Panchayat or ULB verification.

name: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Statutory legal guarantee of wage employment in rural India, providing safety net livelihoods and durable community infrastructure.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Adult members of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual public work.

required_documents: Ration Card / Proof of residence in Gram Panchayat
Bank or Post Office Savings Account (Aadhaar seeded / ABPS enabled)
benefits: Legal entitlement to at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work at notified daily wage rates.
application_method: Application for Job Card submitted to local Gram Panchayat; work allocated within 15 days of demand.

name: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: Incentive scheme to incentivize employers registered with EPFO for creation of new formal employment.

eligibility_rules.criteria: New employees earning wages up to ₹15,000 per month entering the formal workforce with a Universal Account Number (UAN).

required_documents: Universal Account Number (UAN) generated by EPFO
benefits: Government pays the full employer's contribution of 12% towards EPS and EPF for a period of 3 years for new employees, encouraging formal hiring.
application_method: Registered online by employers through EPFO unified portal.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao small deposit savings scheme for girl children offering the highest guaranteed sovereign interest rate and triple tax exemption (EEE).

eligibility_rules.criteria: Account opened in the name of a girl child from birth until she attains the age of 10 years. Maximum 2 accounts per family (triplets/twins exception).

required_documents: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child
Medical Certificate in case of twin/triplet birth
benefits: Government-backed high sovereign interest (currently 8.2% per annum compounding quarterly). Complete tax exemption on deposits, accruals, and maturity under Section 80C. Matures at age 21 or marriage after age 18.
application_method: Opened at any Post Office branch or authorized public/private commercial bank branches.

name: PMMVY (Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Conditional cash transfer maternity benefit program providing compensation for partial wage loss and adequate nutrition during pregnancy and lactation.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Socially and economically disadvantaged pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second child (if girl child). Excludes central/state government employees.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Mother and Husband
Bank / Post Office Account passbook linked with Aadhaar
benefits: ₹5,000 for the first child in two installments, and an additional incentive of ₹6,000 in a single installment for the second child if it is a girl child.
application_method: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or online on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
description: Guaranteed defined pension scheme for all Indian citizens in the unorganized sector to secure guaranteed old-age retirement income.

exclusions: Income tax payers as of 1st October 2022

required_documents: Savings Bank Account with Auto-Debit facility enabled
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after reaching 60 years of age, depending on contribution amount.
application_method: Through bank branch where savings account is held or via Net Banking / APY e-portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: High-affordability accidental death and disability insurance cover for all bank account holders in India.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Active savings bank account with consent for auto-debit.

benefits: Accidental death and full disability cover of ₹2,00,000, and partial permanent disability cover of ₹1,00,000 at an annual premium of just ₹20 per year.
application_method: Auto-debit mandate via Bank branch or internet banking portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Universal one-year renewable life insurance scheme offering life cover on death due to any reason.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Savings bank account with consent for auto-debit of premium.

benefits: Life insurance sum assured of ₹2,00,000 payable to nominee upon death of insured member due to any cause, for a premium of ₹436 per year.
application_method: Submitted through bank branch, post office, or net banking.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / RBI / NABARD
description: Credit facility enabling farmers to access timely and adequate short-term credit for cultivating crops and managing allied post-harvest expenses.
required_documents: Land Ownership Documents (Revenue record showing crop cultivated)
No-dues certificate from adjoining bank branches
benefits: Credit limit based on landholding and cropping pattern with interest subvention resulting in an effective interest rate of just 4% per annum for timely repayments (up to ₹3 Lakhs).
application_method: Apply at local Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Comprehensive risk insurance covering non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages for notified crops.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Growing notified crops in notified areas holding insurable interest in the land.

required_documents: Land Revenue Record / Land Possession Certificate
Sowing Certificate / Declaration issued by Patwari / Village Officer
benefits: Comprehensive claim settlement for crop loss with maximum premium of only 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi food/oilseeds, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops, with remaining premium shared by Government.
application_method: Through PMFBY National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), CSCs, or bank branches.

name: NAPS (National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Skill development initiative promoting on-the-job industrial apprenticeship training to bridge the gap between academic education and industry requirements.

eligibility_rules.education_criteria: Minimum 5th class pass depending on the designated trade.

benefits: Government pays 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice directly to the apprentice's bank account via DBT during training.
application_method: Online registration on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in portal.
source_name: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / KVIC
description: Credit-linked capital subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and services sectors to generate non-farm employment.

eligibility_rules.education_criteria: At least VIII class pass for projects costing above ₹10 Lakhs in manufacturing or above ₹5 Lakhs in service.
eligibility_rules.criteria: Only new projects sanctioned under PMEGP.

required_documents: Educational Qualification Certificate (Class 8th marksheet or above)
EDP Training Certificate (mandatory before fund disbursement)
benefits: Subsidies ranging from 15% to 35% of total project cost (up to ₹50 Lakhs for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakhs for service). Rural special categories receive maximum 35% margin money subsidy.
application_method: Online on KVIC PMEGP e-portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal).

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College Students
ministry: Ministry of Education / Department of Higher Education
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship aimed at providing financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day higher education expenses.

eligibility_rules.education_criteria: Above 80th percentile of successful candidates in Class 12th board examination pursuing regular degree courses.

required_documents: College Admission Fee Receipt and Bonafide Certificate
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum at graduation level for first 3 years and ₹20,000 per annum at postgraduate level, paid directly via DBT.
application_method: Online via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM (National Rural Livelihoods Mission)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Poverty relief mission organizing rural women into Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and federations to foster sustainable self-employment and micro-enterprises.

eligibility_rules.criteria: At least one woman member from each identified poor rural household brought under Self-Help Group network.

benefits: Revolving Fund grant of ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 per SHG, Community Investment Support Fund (CIF) up to ₹1.5 Lakhs, and collateral-free bank credit up to ₹20 Lakhs with interest subvention bringing effective interest down to 7%.
application_method: Through Gram Panchayat level Village Organizations (VO) and Block Mission Management Units (BMMU).

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh
description: State direct benefit transfer scheme empowering married, widowed, divorced, and abandoned women in Madhya Pradesh with regular financial autonomy.

eligibility_rules.landholding_criteria: Family must not hold more than 5 acres of agricultural land

required_documents: Samagra Family ID and Member ID
Aadhaar Card (linked to Samagra and eKYC completed)
Bank Account linked to Aadhaar with DBT enabled
benefits: ₹1,250 per month transferred directly to the woman's bank account on the 10th of every month (₹15,000 annually).
application_method: Camp-based registration organized at Gram Panchayat and Ward level.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (Tamil Nadu)
ministry: Special Programme Implementation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Universal basic rights monthly entitlement honoring the unpaid domestic and caregiving labor of female heads of households in Tamil Nadu.
target_beneficiaries: Women Family Heads in Tamil Nadu

eligibility_rules.landholding_criteria: Less than 5 acres of wetland or 10 acres of dry land
eligibility_rules.electricity_criteria: Annual household electricity consumption below 3,600 units

benefits: ₹1,000 per month transferred directly into the bank accounts of eligible women heads of families (₹12,000 annually).
application_method: Special ration shop camps in Tamil Nadu and online tracking on kmut.tn.gov.in.

name: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Uttar Pradesh
description: Conditional cash transfer program in Uttar Pradesh to establish a positive outlook towards girl child birth, healthcare, and continuous education up to graduation.

eligibility_rules.criteria: Resident of Uttar Pradesh with maximum two girls per family.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Parent and Child
Vaccination Card / School Admission proof (based on stage applied)
benefits: ₹25,000 package provided in 6 stages from birth, complete immunization, Class 1 admission, Class 6, Class 9, to admission in undergraduate/diploma courses.
application_method: Online registration at mksy.up.gov.in or through District Women Welfare Officer.
